newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on the Mexican government's 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.03 percentage points to 1.16 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, at an assigned price of 98.93577 pesos, dealers said.
The bondes were auctioned at the weekly primary auction.
There were 500 million 364-day pesos assigned compared to 1.475 billion pesos worth demanded.
The rate on Mexican government 728-day Bondes, fell 0.02 percentage points to 1.20 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.98909 pesos.
Demand for the bondes was 2.58 billion pesos, compared with the 700 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
